items.title: A new representation of the function Psi in terms of the basic fermionic operators
items.author: Adler, Sergei; Boos, Hermann
items.work: SIGMA 21 (2025), article 010 (Fermionic Basis in Conformal Field Theory and Thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz for Excited States II)
items.difficulty_reason: H3：463-474、713-891把TBA-derived Psi的epsilon expansion转成bosonic-current exponential representation；以generating coefficients u_(n,m)重组无限formal sums计算全部contractions，再用S(h)S(-h)=1的duality将每阶缺失singular terms补齐于作者原式，闭合all-orders induction。难点为nonlinear TBA formal series与operator-exponential对应及singular/regular pieces cancellation，不以公式篇幅判H3。作者appendix明确为简化取无particle-hole excitations，原章节general proposition含E(s,p)；保留作者这项scope说明，不额外声称本轮认证一般激发推广。
